item.title: DoorDash Is Said to Near $17B Takeover of Instacart
item.description: Bloomberg's Ryan Gould joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart parent Maplebear for roughly $17 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. (Source: Bloomberg)
